rv.q: The result is the best solution - that is, one need not have seen a single frame of the film (called "The Celebration" in this country) to appreciate the engrossing, aching, classic Greek inevitability of the family dynamics.
The Dogme 95 film has been turned into a punishing piece of theater that offers little respite from its catalog of familial horrors.
The evening has the airless quality of a party where nobody really wants to be, including the audience.
